contract.description: Modular pipeline blocks for MiniMax-H3-Image: `text2image`, and reference-image editing (`image_conditioned`) when `image` is passed.

inputs.name: prompt
inputs.description: The prompt to guide generation, a single string.

inputs.name: height
inputs.description: Height of the returned image in pixels.

inputs.name: width
inputs.description: Width of the returned image in pixels.

inputs.name: min_generation_area
inputs.description: The smallest area, in pixels, an image is generated at. A smaller `height x width` is generated on a canvas scaled up to this area and resized back to `height x width` after decoding. Pass 1024 to always generate at the requested size.

inputs.name: generator
inputs.description: Torch generator for deterministic generation.

inputs.name: latents
inputs.description: Pre-generated noise of shape `(1, latent_channels, latent_height, latent_width)`, used instead of the draw.

inputs.name: output_type
inputs.description: Output format: 'pil', 'np', 'pt'.

outputs.name: prompt_embeds
outputs.description: The hidden state the transformer conditions on, of shape `(1, num_text_tokens, 5120)`, read after the 50th decoder layer of the Qwen3-VL conditioner.

outputs.name: text_token_tags
outputs.description: The modality tag of every row of `prompt_embeds`, all text for this presentation.

outputs.description: Height of the canvas the image is generated on.

outputs.name: text_indices

outputs.description: How many leading image rows are reference rows: none for `text2image`.

outputs.description: Timesteps of the schedule.

steps.description: Encodes the prompt of a `text2image` request: verbatim, with no chat template and no special tokens, truncated to `max_sequence_length` tokens. The checkpoint is guidance-distilled, so there is no negative prompt and no unconditional branch.

Resolves the canvas an image is generated on. An image smaller than `min_generation_area` pixels is generated on a larger canvas of the same aspect ratio and resized back after decoding; either way the canvas sides are rounded to multiples of 32.
Builds the packed layout of a `text2image` request, `[text | generated image]`, and its float64 rotary grid.
Draws the noise of the generated image as a latent tensor and packs it into rows. An edit draws its reference noise off the same generator after it.

Sets the scheduler to the checkpoint's sampling grid and plans the per-row timesteps of every step. The grid is fixed: the transformer has one output head per step of it. The reference rows of an edit stay at their conditioning level for every step.
Runs the MiniMax-H3-Image denoising loop, one forward pass per step.

Runs the one transformer forward pass of a denoising iteration, which predicts the velocity of every image row of the packed sequence through the output head of that step. The checkpoint is guidance-distilled, so there is no unconditional pass and no guider.
Steps the generated rows down the schedule. Only the generated rows are ever written, so the reference rows of an edit survive the whole loop.

Turns the denoised rows of the packed sequence back into latents: drops the reference rows the loop never wrote, then unpacks the generated rows into `(1, latent_channels, latent_height, latent_width)`. The decoder then takes latents from any source, and popping it leaves latents in hand.

Denormalizes the generated latents and decodes them into an image. The VAE produces ImageNet-normalized RGB that is reverted here. An image generated on a larger canvas than requested is resized back to `output_height x output_width`.

steps.description: Resizes the reference images of an edit, once for the VAE and once for the text encoder. Each copy keeps the original pixels when its short edge is within the consumer's bounds, and is otherwise scaled to the nearer bound with both sides rounded to multiples of 32. The references are never resized to the size of the generated image.

Encodes the presentation of an edit: a `Picture i: ` label and a vision block per reference image, then the prompt verbatim, with no chat template and no special tokens. The prompt and every label are truncated to `max_sequence_length` tokens. The checkpoint is guidance-distilled, so there is no negative prompt and no unconditional branch.
Encodes the reference images of an edit into conditioning latents. Each posterior is sampled off the request's generator, rounded to float16, cropped to whole patches and normalized.

Resolves the canvas an image is generated on. An image smaller than `min_generation_area` pixels is generated on a larger canvas of the same aspect ratio and resized back after decoding; either way the canvas sides are rounded to multiples of 32.
Builds the packed layout of an edit, `[text | reference images | generated image]`, and its float64 rotary grid. Every reference keeps its own latent grid.
Draws the noise of the generated image as a latent tensor and packs it into rows. An edit draws its reference noise off the same generator after it.

Noises the reference latents of an edit to the conditioning level, packs them into rows and puts them in front of the generated rows, which is where the layout reserved them. One noise tensor per reference is drawn off the request's generator, after the noise of the generated image. The denoising loop only ever writes the generated rows, so the conditioning rides through every step unchanged.

Sets the scheduler to the checkpoint's sampling grid and plans the per-row timesteps of every step. The grid is fixed: the transformer has one output head per step of it. The reference rows of an edit stay at their conditioning level for every step.
Runs the MiniMax-H3-Image denoising loop, one forward pass per step.

Runs the one transformer forward pass of a denoising iteration, which predicts the velocity of every image row of the packed sequence through the output head of that step. The checkpoint is guidance-distilled, so there is no unconditional pass and no guider.
Steps the generated rows down the schedule. Only the generated rows are ever written, so the reference rows of an edit survive the whole loop.

Turns the denoised rows of the packed sequence back into latents: drops the reference rows the loop never wrote, then unpacks the generated rows into `(1, latent_channels, latent_height, latent_width)`. The decoder then takes latents from any source, and popping it leaves latents in hand.

Denormalizes the generated latents and decodes them into an image. The VAE produces ImageNet-normalized RGB that is reverted here. An image generated on a larger canvas than requested is resized back to `output_height x output_width`.

The references are never resized to the size of the generated image.
